items.title: Multi-Sourced, Multi-Agent Evidence Retrieval for Fact-Checking
items.title_zh: 面向事实核查的多源多智能体证据检索
items.summary: WKGFC treats an authorized open knowledge graph as the core evidence source: an LLM agent retrieves the most relevant knowledge subgraphs for a claim, supplements them with web content, and runs the process as a Markov decision process tuned through prompt optimization. The authors position the approach as addressing the limits of text-similarity retrieval for multi-hop fact-checking.

items.title: Query Disambiguation via Answer-Free Context: Doubling Performance on Humanity's Last Exam
items.title_zh: 借助无答案上下文消解查询歧义：在 Humanity's Last Exam 上性能翻倍
items.summary: The authors find that rewriting a question to reduce ambiguity using answer-free grounding context improves accuracy without changing the answer, and that the gain cannot be fully recovered by inference-time prompting alone. Using gpt-oss-20b to rewrite a subset of Humanity's Last Exam raises gpt-5-mini accuracy from 0.14 to 0.37.

items.title: Introducing the Stateful Runtime Environment for Agents in Amazon Bedrock
items.title_zh: 在 Amazon Bedrock 中为智能体引入有状态运行时环境
items.summary: OpenAI describes a stateful runtime environment for agents in Amazon Bedrock that adds persistent orchestration, memory and secure execution to multi-step AI workflows.

items.title: A Mixed Diet Makes DINO An Omnivorous Vision Encoder
items.title_zh: 混合“食谱”让 DINO 成为杂食性视觉编码器
items.summary: The authors observe that DINOv2 features for an RGB image and its depth map are nearly as dissimilar as features of unrelated images, and propose an Omnivorous Vision Encoder that post-trains an encoder toward a modality-agnostic feature space. A dual objective aligns different modalities of the same scene while distilling from a frozen teacher, and the model weights are released.

items.title: How Well Do Multimodal Models Reason on ECG Signals?
items.title_zh: 多模态模型在心电图信号上的推理能力如何？
items.summary: The paper proposes a reproducible framework that splits multimodal ECG reasoning evaluation into perception, checked by agent-generated code verifying the described temporal structures, and deduction, checked for alignment with a structured database of clinical criteria via retrieval. The authors present this dual verification as a scalable alternative to manual clinician review and proxy QA metrics.

items.title: Quantifying Catastrophic Forgetting in IoT Intrusion Detection Systems
items.title_zh: 量化 IoT 入侵检测系统中的灾难性遗忘
items.summary: The study formulates intrusion detection in RPL-based IoT networks as domain continual learning and benchmarks five strategies across multiple domain orderings on a multi-attack dataset comprising 48 domains. Replay-based methods perform best overall, while Synaptic Intelligence shows near-zero forgetting with high training efficiency, pointing to stable deployment under shifting attacks.

items.title: Beyond the Click: A Framework for Inferring Cognitive Traces in Search
items.title_zh: 超越点击：推断搜索中认知轨迹的框架
items.summary: The paper infers cognitive traces from behavioral search logs with a multi-agent LLM system grounded in Information Foraging Theory and validated by human experts. It annotates three public datasets with over 530,000 cognitive labels across 50,000 sessions; on MovieLens the cognitive model improves F1 by up to 6.6% over a behavioral baseline, while gains are near zero on AOL.

items.title: COOP$^2$: Defining, Observing, and Repairing Cooperation in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: COOP²：定义、观测并修复 LLM 多智能体系统中的协作
items.summary: COOP² is an evaluation framework that grounds cooperation dynamics in LLM multi-agent systems in task progress, paired with COOP²-Repair, which predicts constraint failures from group plans and opens targeted repair channels. Across two environments and three communication structures, repair improved task success and constraint satisfaction while adding decision overhead and communication load.

items.title: Universal Conceptual Structure in Neural Translation: Probing NLLB-200's Multilingual Geometry
items.title_zh: 神经翻译中的通用概念结构：探测 NLLB-200 的多语言几何
items.summary: Probing Meta's 200-language NLLB-200 in six experiments, the author finds that embedding distances correlate with phylogenetic distances and that frequently colexified concept pairs are significantly more similar, among other evidence of language-universal conceptual structure. The InterpretCognates toolkit is released openly.

items.title: appeeky/aso-skills

items.title: We gave terabytes of CI logs to an LLM
items.title_zh: 我们把数 TB 的 CI 日志交给大模型
items.summary: The post describes giving an AI agent a SQL interface to billions of CI log lines stored in ClickHouse, and how the team ingests, stores and queries about 1.5 billion log lines per week.
